episodes.synopsis: Hiroshi Yuuki is having one really bad day. He can't wait to get home and fire up a new virtual reality MMO so he can forget all about it. What could go wrong?
episodes.title: VR⨯Reality

episodes.synopsis: Given the difficulty of Hiro's unique situation in the game, Reona and Hiro decide to seek the help of one of the few remaining players in Kiwame Quest.
episodes.title: Living in a Dead Game

episodes.synopsis: After being betrayed by Ginji, Hiro is arrested by the City Guard. Can he find a way to clear himself or escape?
episodes.title: Adult Event Time

episodes.synopsis: Hiro's traumatic Kiwame Quest play session reminds him of the past. His resolve to quit Kiwame Quest is tested.
episodes.title: The Only One to Beat the Game

episodes.synopsis: Hiro is taken before the Tesla, captain of the City Guard. The interaction has important ramifications for his ability to play Kiwame Quest. Reona attempts to provide Hiro with guidance.
episodes.title: The Tribulation of a Killer

episodes.synopsis: Mizarisa and Alicia clash over Hiro. After the battle, Hiro starts to understand Kamui's advice.
episodes.title: Knife vs. Saw

episodes.synopsis: Hiro and Reona return to find the city of Ted in a state of panic. Hiro's newfound change in attitude spurs him to action, and his bold choices open the door to an exciting opportunity.
episodes.title: Chance of Survival 0.1%

episodes.synopsis: Hiro begins training as part of the City Guard. However, things don't go quite like he imagined.
episodes.title: Enlistment and Baptism

episodes.synopsis: Hiro's mentally gruelling time training with the City Guard continues. As the difficulties continue, Hiro grows discouraged. Can he find a way to turn things around and endure until the second goblin assault?
episodes.title: A Fairy's Power

episodes.synopsis: Hiro has endured the 5 days of City Guard training, and the day of the goblin assault is finally upon him. His achievements have earned him the right to learn the trick to Kiwame Quest, but will it be enough?
episodes.title: A New Ally

episodes.synopsis: The goblin assault has begun. A problem from Hiro's past returns to haunt him, and Hiro learns why his chance of survival is only 0.1%.
episodes.title: City of Dead Ends

episodes.synopsis: Hiro has learned the true nature of the City of Ted, and now he has to die. Can Hiro save his console from nearly certain destruction?
episodes.title: Reality⨯VR
